name: How long does a typical bathroom electrical and lighting upgrade project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical bathroom electrical and lighting upgrade project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a bathroom electrical and lighting upgrade project depends on its complexity. Minor upgrades, such as replacing a few light fixtures or adding a new outlet, might take a single day. More extensive projects involving new wiring, panel upgrades, or the installation of multiple recessed lights and dedicated circuits could take several days to a week. We provide a projected timeline during the initial consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration for bathroom electrical and lighting upgrades varies from one day for minor changes to several days for extensive work.
